entities.summary: Catherine Elizabeth McAuley, RSM was an Irish Catholic religious sister who founded the Sisters of Mercy in 1831. The women's congregation has always been associated with teaching, especially in Ireland, where the sisters taught Catholics at a time when education was mainly reserved for members of the established Church of Ireland. Catherine McAuley was a religious figures from Dublin (1778-09-29, Dublin–1841-11-11). Holds notable historical significance, documented across 0 language editions of Wikipedia.
